Findings: Lane 04 measured recall (synthetic, 24 docs, K=6): gating drives leakage from 4–5 records to 0 and RAISES in-scope recall (semantic 0.17→1.00, lexical 0.33→0.67) because ungated runs spent top-K slots on unreadable bait; scoped semantic beats scoped lexical (1.00 vs 0.67) and exact (0.17).; warning: liveness controls caught three vacuous passes in oracle-derived tests — readable tenant names, post bodies missing entry_type, and human_ruling on a decision record all FAIL ADMISSION SILENTLY, so exclusion assertions passed against records never in the store. Rule for every lane: assert the seed projected before scoring an exclusion.; Discovered need: computeResolvedIds must run over the AUTHORIZATION slice, not the query slice (decision 01KYB5EM805A90TR9MR9WK2E04: resolvers are posted cross-scope); gating them by query path made resolved needs resurface forever — caught by deep-review-regressions.; Lane 04 full suite: 2096 passed / 40 todo; two files (server-startup, telemetry-client) fail only because src/analytics/_generated-posthog-key.ts is missing in a fresh worktree (pretest injects it) — environmental, verify at merge.
